    N = 491  # Number of vertical supports
    bridge_length = 20.0  # from x=10 to x=30
    dx = bridge_length / (N - 1)  # spacing between vertical supports

    # Create vertical supports
    vertical_beams = []
    for i in range(N):
        x = 10.0 + i * dx
        # Vertical beam: width=0.1 m, height=5.0 m
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x, 8.0, width=0.1, height=5.0)
        vertical_beams.append(beam)
        # Anchor the vertical beam to the ground at (x, 5.5)
        joint = sandbox.add_joint(beam, None, (x, 5.5), type='rigid')

    # Create horizontal beams
    horizontal_beams = []
    for i in range(N - 1):
        x1 = 10.0 + i * dx
        x2 = 10.0 + (i + 1) * dx
        center_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
        # Horizontal beam: width=0.1 m, height=0.1 m
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(center_x, 10.5, width=0.1, height=0.1)
        horizontal_beams.append(beam)
        # Connect to adjacent vertical beams
        joint1 = sandbox.add_joint(beam, vertical_beams[i], (x1, 10.5), type='rigid')
        joint2 = sandbox.add_joint(beam, vertical_beams[i + 1], (x2, 10.5), type='rigid')

    # Return a reference to the bridge structure
    return vertical_beams[0]
